I don't think this should be on the source code plugin. I'm envisioning that there could be a single source code plugin for godot-cpp (which would know generally how extensions built with godot-cpp work), but this is information that we need from each individual GDExtension.

If you've got, say, 3 extensions build with godot-cpp, I don't think it makes sense to have 3 `EditorExtensionSourceCodePlugin`s (and we'd have to dynamically generate them or something too, because they'd each need a unique class name in each extension)

I think we're on the same page. I also envision a single source code plugin for each language, that's why the `get_language_XXXX` functions are in the plugin.

I was thinking the godot-cpp plugin would be able to get the information it needs from the GDExtensions built with godot-cpp. I imagine this would be entirely handled by the specific plugin and different languages may have different mechanisms to get this information. If godot-cpp needs this additional API in the GDExtension class that's fine, it just seems godot-cpp specific to me.

Either way, I don't think this would require making any changes to this PR, if I understood correctly. And https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111922 can be a complementary addition.
